name: Punda
tagline: The postcard side of the channel
description: The eastern half of the historic centre, where the painted merchant houses of the Handelskade line the water and the floating market sells Venezuelan produce from boats. It is the most photographed part of Curacao and holds the Mikve Israel-Emanuel synagogue.
bestFor: Short stays wanting to be inside the UNESCO centre
pros: The Handelskade waterfront at the door
The oldest synagogue in continuous use in the Americas
cons: Busy with cruise passengers by day
Quiet at night once shops close

name: Otrobanda
tagline: The other side, larger and less restored
description: The western half of the historic city, reached by the Queen Emma pontoon bridge that swings open for shipping. It is bigger, less restored and more residential than Punda, with the Kura Hulanda museum and a street art scene through its older blocks.
bestFor: Longer stays wanting the centre at a lower price
pros: Cheaper than Punda for the same location
Kura Hulanda museum and the older streets
Walk across the pontoon bridge to Punda
cons: Some blocks need care after dark

name: Pietermaai
tagline: The restored district where people actually go out
description: A strip of nineteenth-century townhouses east of Punda, derelict for decades and restored over the last fifteen years into the island's concentration of bars, restaurants, boutique hotels and coworking. It is where most of Curacao's remote workers end up.
bestFor: Remote workers who want coworking and a bar within walking distance
pros: Ten minutes on foot to Punda
cons: Noise from the bars at weekends
Small swimming spots rather than beaches

name: Jan Thiel
tagline: The beach club end, modern and Dutch
description: A developed area southeast of the city built around Jan Thiel beach and its beach clubs, with modern apartments, supermarkets and a largely Dutch resident population. It has none of the historic centre's character and all of its convenience.
bestFor: Anyone wanting a beach, a pool and new-build housing
pros: Beach clubs and swimmable water at the door
Newest apartment stock on the island
cons: Twenty minutes from Willemstad by car

name: Westpunt
tagline: The far west, where the diving is
description: The northwestern tip of the island, forty minutes from the city, with the small bays of Playa Kenepa, Playa Piskado and Grote Knip, and the shore diving that Curacao is known for. Christoffel National Park is behind it.
bestFor: Divers and anyone who wants the coast rather than the city
pros: The island's best beaches and shore diving
